params.description: URL parameters to append to the URL. Sent as a dictionary of key-value pairs.

query.description: The query parameter for search or filtering.

page.description: The page number parameter for pagination. Used to retrieve a specific page of results.

auth.description: HTTP authentication credentials formatted as a (username, password) tuple.

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (.pem), if required for the request.

cookies.description: Cookies to send with the request as a dictionary of cookie names and values.

sessionid.description: Session identifier cookie, used to recognize client sessions on the server.

csrftoken.description: CSRF protection token cookie, used to prevent cross-site request forgery attacks.

proxies.description: Proxy settings as a dictionary, mapping protocol or protocol and hostname to the URL of the proxy.

http.description: Proxy URL to use for HTTP requests, including the port number.

https.description: Proxy URL to use for HTTPS requests, including the port number.

stream.description: Whether to stream the download of the response. If False, the response content will be immediately downloaded. Streaming is useful for handling large files or responses.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate or not. Set to False to skip certificate verification, which is not recommended unless you are sure of the server's identity.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference guide to the most popular public APIs that let you look up business / company data (and sometimes contact details) based on an IP address. All of them expose a simple REST endpoint; you’ll usually need an API key (free tiers exist). I’ve added a short “how‑to” snippet for each so you can test it right away. | # | Service | Key Features | Free Tier | Typical Pricing | Example Endpoint | Sample Response | |---|---------|--------------|-----------|-----------------|------------------|-----------------| | 1 | **ipinfo.io** | • Organization name
• Domain
• ASN
• Company logo (if available)
• Contact email & phone (in paid plans) | 50k requests/month, limited fields | $5/mo for 1M requests + extra features | `https://ipinfo.io//json` | ```json{ "org":"AS15169 Google LLC", "hostname":"google.com", "company":{"name":"Google","domain":"google.com","logo":"https://logo.clearbit.com/google.com"}}``` | | 2 | **ipapi.co** | • Org name
• Domain
• Phone (paid)
• Email (paid) | 30k requests/day, limited fields | $9.99/mo for 250k reqs + extras | `https://ipapi.co//json/` | ```json{ "org":"Google Inc.", "domain":"google.com", "phone":"+1-650-253-0000" }``` | | 3 | **ipstack.com** | • Organization
• Domain
• Phone (paid)
• Email (paid) | 10k requests/month, limited fields | $10/mo for 500k reqs + extras | `http://api.ipstack.com/?access_key=YOUR_KEY&fields=ip,organization,domain,phone,email` | ```json{ "ip":"8.8.8.8", "organization":"Google LLC", "domain":"google.com", "phone":"+1-650-253-0000", "email":"support@google.com" }``` | | 4 | **Clearbit Enrichment** | • Company profile (logo, description, size, industry)
• Contact email & phone (via Clearbit Connect) | 2000 requests/month, limited fields | $49/mo for 25k reqs + extras | `https://person.clearbit.com/v1/companies/find?domain=` (requires domain, but you can get domain from IP first) | ```json{ "name":"Google LLC", "description":"Search engine giant", "size": "10000+", "industry":"Internet", "logo":"https://logo.clearbit.com/google.com" }``` | | 5 | **Hunter.io** | • Company domain → email patterns
• Verify email addresses | 150 requests/month | $49/mo for 5000 reqs + extras | `https://api.hunter.io/v2/domain-search?domain=&api_key=YOUR_KEY` | ```json{ "domain":"google.com", "emails":[{"value":"support@google.com","type":"support"}] }``` | --- ### How to Call These APIs #### 1️⃣ ipinfo.io – Simple GET ```python import requests ip = "8.8.8.8" resp = requests.get(f"https://ipinfo.io/{ip}/json") data = resp.json() print(data["org"]) # AS15169 Google LLC print(data["company"]["logo"]) ``` *If you need the company logo, add `?fields=company.logo`.* #### 2️⃣ ipapi.co – Add API Key ```python import requests ip = "8.8.8.8" key = "YOUR_IPAPI_KEY" resp = requests.get(f"https://ipapi.co/{ip}/json/", params={"access_key": key}) data = resp.json() print(data["org"], data["phone"]) ``` #### 3️⃣ ipstack.com – Custom Fields ```python import requests ip = "8.8.8.8" key = "YOUR_IPSTACK_KEY" fields = "ip,organization,domain,phone,email" resp = requests.get("http://api.ipstack.com/" + ip, params={"access_key": key, "fields": fields}) data = resp.json() print(data) ``` #### 4️⃣ Clearbit Enrichment – Requires Domain ```python import requests domain = "google.com" key = "YOUR_CLEARBIT_KEY" resp = requests.get(f"https://person.clearbit.com/v1/companies/find?domain={domain}", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {key}"}) data = resp.json() print(data["name"], data["logo"]) ``` #### 5️⃣ Hunter.io – Find Emails ```python import requests domain = "google.com" key = "YOUR_HUNTER_KEY" resp = requests.get(f"https://api.hunter.io/v2/domain-search?domain={domain}&api_key={key}") data = resp.json() for e in data["data"]["emails"]: print(e["value"], e["type"]) ``` --- ### Things to Keep in Mind | Topic | Notes | |-------|-------| | **Rate Limits** | All free tiers have daily/monthly caps. Exceeding triggers throttling or billing. | | **Privacy** | Some providers refuse to return personal emails for privacy reasons. | | **Accuracy** | Data quality varies; always validate against multiple sources if critical. | | **Legal** | Make sure you comply with GDPR / CCPA when storing or using contact info. | | **Caching** | IP → company mapping rarely changes; cache responses for at least 24–48 h to stay within quotas. | --- ### Quick Starter Code (Python) Here’s a tiny wrapper that tries all three major services in order until it finds a company record: ```python import requests def lookup_company(ip): # 1️⃣ Try ipinfo.io try: r = requests.get(f"https://ipinfo.io/{ip}/json") d = r.json() if "org" in d: return {"provider":"ipinfo", "org":d["org"]} except Exception: pass # 2️⃣ Try ipapi.co try: r = requests.get(f"https://ipapi.co/{ip}/json/", params={"access_key":"YOUR_IPAPI_KEY"}) d = r.json() if "org" in d: return {"provider":"ipapi", "org":d["org"]} except Exception: pass # 3️⃣ Try ipstack.com try: r = requests.get("http://api.ipstack.com/" + ip, params={"access_key":"YOUR_IPSTACK_KEY", "fields":"organization"}) d = r.json() if "organization" in d: return {"provider":"ipstack", "org":d["organization"]} except Exception: pass return None print(lookup_company("8.8.8.8")) ``` Replace the placeholder keys with your own. Once you have the domain (`google.com`) you can feed it into Clearbit or Hunter to pull logos, descriptions, or email patterns. --- ### Bottom Line - **ipinfo.io** and **ipapi.co** are the easiest to start with—just hit the `/json` endpoint. - For richer contact data (phone, email, logo), combine the IP lookup with **Clearbit** or **Hunter.io**. - All services offer a free tier; pick one that matches your traffic volume and feature needs. Happy hunting!
